title: KAD-PI Counterfactual Observatory & Longitudinal Divergence Journal
non_scope: logging prompts, completions, chain-of-thought, or auth tokens
external databases or network polling daemons
acceptance_criteria: Wayfinder decision establishes runtime append-only tamper-evident journal under XDG state + bounded deterministic evidence export.
Machine-readable schema kad-shadow-observation-v1 defines structured observation event with deterministic sequence and hash chaining.
Epistemic separation contract enforces strict distinction between OBSERVED, COUNTERFACTUAL, DERIVED, and ESTIMATED_COUNTERFACTUAL without claiming unexecuted empirical savings.
Evaluation policy is frozen with deterministic fingerprinting (policy fingerprint + evaluator fingerprint); changes create distinct logical experiments.
Append-only journal implements atomic writes, hash-chain integrity (previous_hash + current_event -> event_hash), historical tampering detection, malformed-tail recovery, and bounded retention.
Privacy and secret protection strictly enforced: prompts, completions, CoT, files, Authorization headers, cookies, API keys are never persisted.
Longitudinal aggregation computes total, comparable, agreement/divergence counts, divergence rates, opportunity classes, actual tokens/costs, and tokenmaxxing metrics.
Deterministic evidence export command/function creates bounded snapshot in evidence/WP-KAD-COUNTERFACTUAL-OBSERVATORY-004/.
Observatory surfaced through bin/kad observatory and bin/kad observatory --json with zero verbose noise in compact status bar.
All 24 required TDD test cases (T1-T24) pass and all 464+ regression tests remain green.
description: Longitudinal counterfactual observatory and append-only tamper-evident divergence journal tracking actual vs shadow economic routing decisions without granting shadow execution authority or making unsupported empirical savings claims.
